newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African petrol product sales up 5.9 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: S.African petrol product sales up 5.9 pct in 1996.

text.p: Major petroleum product sales in South Africa grew 5.9 percent last year to 20.26 billion litres, the South African Petroleum Industry Association (SAPIA) said on Thursday.

"This growth of 5.9 percent was achieved in spite of the significantly higher prices of petroleum products which prevailed in South Africa in 1996 as a result of the combined effect of the weakness of the rand and higher international oil prices," a statement said.
"This compares with growth of 5.3 percent for 1995 over 1994."
Last year gasoline sales grew 4.1 percent, diesel sales 6.0 percent, jet fuel sales 17 percent and paraffin 7.9 percent.
"The penetration of unleaded petrol as a percentage of total petrol sales was 9.3 percent in December," the statement said.
